name: io.github.unempyd/revenueos
description: RevenueOS Community over MCP: connect a business and run its SEO Auditor, Ads Auditor, Lead Discovery, Sales Follow-up, Marketing Intelligence and Revenue Monitor capabilities. Nothing sends, publishes or spends without an explicit approve + execute.

environment_variables.name: REVENUEOS_ROOT
environment_variables.description: Path to the onboarded RevenueOS workspace (company-context/ + skills/). Defaults to the current directory when unset.

environment_variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional: enables LLM-driven personalisation and skill execution. Workers still run their deterministic path without it.

environment_variables.name: REVENUEOS_DRY_RUN
environment_variables.description: Set to 1 (the Community default) to write outreach sends to data/outputs/ instead of over real SMTP.
